Free CSCA Study Help & Mentor Requests

Ask the CSCA Prep WhatsApp community for help with practice questions and study plans. Individual help depends on volunteer availability.

Last reviewed 27 October 20262 min readBy CSCA Prep Academy

Ask the CSCA Prep WhatsApp community for help with a practice question or study plan. Individual support depends on volunteer availability; the platform does not promise an assigned tutor, a response deadline or a particular exam outcome.

Prepare a useful question

Include the subject, question text, your attempted method and the step you do not understand. Explain whether you are stuck on a concept, algebra, terminology or timing. A specific question is easier to discuss than a request to review an entire syllabus at once.

Use the practice tools first

Read the worked explanation, revisit the relevant subject guide, and try a related question. If the explanation appears wrong, contact the team with the question identifier and the reasoning that led you to a different answer.

Request individual help

Use the WhatsApp links on the contact page. Explain what help you need and your availability. A coordinator can tell you whether someone is available; requesting help does not guarantee a match. Confirm a volunteer’s experience yourself before relying on specialist advice.

Protect your account and application

Do not share passwords, exam identity documents or payment credentials in a study group. Use official university or scholarship channels for decisions about eligibility, documents and deadlines. Community advice does not replace those requirements.

Sources and scope

CSCA official portal — current sitting notices, registration, candidate instructions and results.

Shanghai government CSCA guide — subject format and the role of CSCA in undergraduate applications.

Campus China — Chinese Government Scholarship information. Use the receiving university’s current program notice for admission and funding requirements.

This is independent preparation guidance. Requirements can differ by university, program, scholarship and intake. Follow the official notice that applies to your application.
